rows.requested_evidence: Utility letter for named parcel and point of interconnection with firm or conditional 25 MW facility input capacity
rows.acceptance_test: Named service point plus all conditions and dated capacity ramp

rows.requested_evidence: Written energization schedule for initial phase and full 25 MW; upgrades and dependencies
rows.acceptance_test: Dates and critical path are explicit; meet project milestones

rows.requested_evidence: Applicable tariff or proposal including energy demand transmission upgrade fees minimum take collateral and escalation
rows.acceptance_test: Comparable 10-year cash flows can be constructed

rows.requested_evidence: Utility interruption history at proposed feeder; supply configuration; backup and curtailment terms
rows.acceptance_test: Reliability can be reconciled with workload SLA and engineering design

rows.requested_evidence: Two providers or physically diverse routes with capacity price construction date and campus latencies
rows.acceptance_test: Capacity and measured p95/p99 satisfy eligible services

rows.requested_evidence: Cooling concept water supply and discharge letters and high-density rack thermal design
rows.acceptance_test: Cooling works at phased loads with accepted water and permit conditions

rows.requested_evidence: Parcel control zoning building environmental air/noise permit pathway and schedule
rows.acceptance_test: No unmitigated legal or construction blocker

rows.requested_evidence: Parcel-address FEMA flood map USGS seismic local severe weather and insurer assessment
rows.acceptance_test: Mitigations and cost can be engineered and priced

rows.requested_evidence: Dataset agreements institutional operator roles access controls audit and secure-enclave approval
rows.acceptance_test: Restricted workload only assigned when project-specific permission is documented

rows.requested_evidence: Project-by-project controlled technology/source-code classification and access plan including remote users
rows.acceptance_test: Institutional export-control review documents any applicable restriction or exception
